messages:
tara: creating RC candidate rc-2026-03-23-b with artifact tag v2.15.0-candidate. uploading release notes draft here: https://internal.redwood/releases/rc-2026-03-23-b :spiral_note_pad:
kyler: quick check — does this build include the analytics migration? we have a pre-scheduled analytics window at 16:20Z.
marc: it does include analytics migration `20260323_analytics_v2.sql` but we planned it as optional gated by `analytics.migrate=true` during canary.
oncall-jen: heads-up from infra: db-team has a scheduled lock 16:10-16:25Z for a shard reorg in eu-central, would prefer canary outside that.
opsbot: proposed canary schedule: start=2026-03-23T16:00Z, canary_pct=5, duration=25m, run_id=deploy_9921.
tara: let's avoid overlap. can we move to 16:30Z? that pushes into the analytics window though.
kyler: if we must move, prefer micro-canary in us-east at 16:00Z then global expand at 16:35Z after db window. keeps migrations isolated.
devbot: note: KV prewarm required for ranking-service. recommend `kv-warm --svc ranking-service --sample 50k` at T-10m.
marc: agree with split approach. add step to intel: run analytics migration only after global expand: gate by `analytics.migrate=false` during micro-canary.
oncall-jen: I'll be oncall during both windows. set alerts for p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and mongo locks. threshold: error-rate > 0.8% or p95 > 250ms -> pause.
opsbot: updated schedule: micro-canary us-east 2026-03-23T16:00Z (10m), global canary start 2026-03-23T16:35Z (15m), run_id=deploy_9921. KV-warm for ranking-service at 15:50Z.
tara: tagging rollback owner: @marc. please add rollback steps to notes and keep contact info.
marc: rollback playbook (short):
```
1) exec `deploy rollback --id deploy_9921`
2) set traffic to pinned tag `v2.14.9-stable`
3) run `kv-clear --svc ranking-service` and `kv-clear --svc embed-service`
4) disable `analytics.migrate` flag and revert migration if partial
5) page oncall and post to #incidents
```
marc: I'll own rollback. pager channel: pager 1.
kyler: product sign-off: confirmed wording and migration notes OK. :thumbsup:
oncall-jen: infra ack. will watch DB lock metrics closely during the 16:10-16:25 window.
deploy-bot: deploy_9921 queued. use `deploy status deploy_9921` and `deploy logs deploy_9921` to follow progress.
tara: final note: if micro-canary passes (no alerts) we expand to global 5% at 16:35Z, kick analytics migration only after expansion and a 5m stable window.
marc: adding a one-line rollback checklist into the release notes and pinning the artifact in the release doc.
tara: thanks everyone. leaving thread open for live canary updates. will post success/failure and final promotion to prod here.
